semantics.names: Seven initial child names reserved atomically; existing six IDs stable, VASpace uses slot6. Event aliases rejected.

semantics.failure: Malformed success, timeout and failed ACK retain names/backing; logical stop hides the address-space view.
semantics.free: Events then VASpace then I2C then base objects. Free rejection retains VASpace/parents; acknowledged object free is not global GPU quiescence.

facts.owner: Actual DriverHeap/DMA callbacks, stable native graph/session and nine reserved child names. Existing seven names unchanged; memory/virtual use slots7/8.
facts.storage: 12288 bytes, three4K pages, CPU WB, DMA bidirectional/coherent,47-bit DMA mask. Zero before DMA map, explicit device sync before registration; bounce and aliases rejected. Resident descriptor/page stamps invalidate stale views.
facts.rpc: ALLOC_MEMORY4 original56-byte header plus three8-byte page numbers; NV50_MEMORY_VIRTUAL0x50a0 raw128-byte params via GSP_ALLOC103; MAP14 original56-byte NVOS46; UNMAP15 original40-byte NVOS47, not the newer48-byte NVOS47.
facts.virtual: DMA type6, exact12288-byte range, forced4K alignment, pitch/system/cached CPU attributes, GPU cache disabled, RM-managed page tables. Validated returned VA and byte limit within current49-bit VASpace; no invented address or external PDB.
facts.mapping: Relative offset0 maps the registered system pages into the confirmed VA range. Cache snoop enabled; map/unmap do not defer TLB invalidation. These acknowledged operations do not prove actual GPU data execution.
facts.lifetime: Before any possibly visible registration TX, leaf cleanup is disabled. Data/map publication follows validated reply plus ACK. Parent, transport, deadline, copied owner and current VASpace remain bound.
facts.rejection: Confirmed allocation/map rejection reverses only the proven prefix and preserves receiver discovery. Host allocation/pin/map/sync failure before RPC is cleaned privately; failed local cleanup stays represented.
facts.free: Events -> GPU unmap -> virtual object free -> registered memory free -> DMA unmap -> unpin -> heap release -> VASpace -> I2C -> base. Uncertain replies/ACK/timeouts/free retain parents and reachable pages; no replay or forced cleanup.
facts.diagnostic: GSP-CONTROL reports RM names, GPU VA, byte length and lack of channels, or precise failing operation/reply and retained states.
facts.common_bo_gap: Kernel0.1.153 GfxDriverMemoryApi25 uses the legacy lifecycle guard and is not yet authenticated/synchronized for ordinary Driver Work. Direct app BO import/map requires that software integration; the existing work-capable DriverHeap/DMA path owns private control pages only.

bo_work_checkpoint.status: Common driver BO Work admission and native private control BO integrated; 0.79.11 remains open
bo_work_checkpoint.scope: Authenticated common BO APIs in ordinary Driver Work, synchronized device residency, close-race retention, and actual NVIDIA private control BO registration/mapping. General app GPU resources, VRAM placement and execution channels remain software work.

facts.binding: The actual nonwrapping module start epoch binds graphics ownership before DriverInit. Pre-Task binding uses only the BSP boot lifecycle, before SMP; BO operations require an authenticated Task. No lazy first-call epoch creation can miss close.
facts.concurrency: Shared BO metadata owner serializes the driver and device tables; a busy device record and backing lease are reserved before the DMA page walk. VM allocation/free, long page walks and payload access occur outside the owner.
facts.context: Init/ordinary Work/Shutdown resolve the actual caller on every call. IRQ, storage callbacks and dedicated tasks cannot borrow cached tables. Work queries return zero MMIO slots; cached legacy MMIO calls remain rejected.
facts.collect: Work collects BOs and reads synchronized MMIO retirement state. Healthy live windows do not cause false Busy; in-progress or failed MMIO retirement remains Busy and is retried only from Init/Shutdown.
facts.close: New query/create/import/map/acquire admission closes before DriverShutdown; existing describe/segment/unmap/release/collect remain usable. Retention is checked again after Work quiesces, before generic DMA/heap/module destruction.
facts.native_storage: One 12-KB common system BO, exclusive CPU zeroing with WB unmap visibility, three direct page-bounded DMA segments under a 47-bit mask. No private heap buffer, legacy DMA pin, bounce copy or pointer substitution.
facts.gpu_residency: The native PCI adapter and exact GSP epoch bind both residency leases. GPU-VA residency is acquired only after RM map response AND queue ACK; admission failure confirms reverse RPC teardown before BO release.
facts.release: RM unmap and both object frees precede common GPU residency, DMA residency, pending CPU map, BO reference and collection. Failures retain the remaining exact handles and parents.
facts.abi: DriverApi 35/648 and GfxDriverMemoryApi 1/112 byte layouts unchanged. Existing optional callbacks and SDK facades suffice; older Work providers expose no admission.
facts.default: Passive NVIDIA and bootfb remain standard; no OssiPC contact or native hardware execution.
